notes: SARS standard VAT is 15%: bars and jewellery are standard-rated; only SARB gold coins (Krugerrands) are zero-rated (VAT Act s11(1)(k)). MetCon's published buy-back table: minted gold bars at metal price -2%, silver bars -5% (VAT added back for SA residents on undamaged bars bought incl. VAT). Premiums dropped - no primary spot could be read (old file used a banned aggregator).

sources.name: South African Revenue Service - Value-Added Tax
sources.what: VAT is levied at the standard rate of 15% on the supply of goods and services by registered vendors; taxable supplies are charged at the standard rate (currently 15%) or the zero rate - gold bars and jewellery are standard-rated at 15%.

sources.name: SARS - Binding General Ruling (VAT) 43: Deduction of input tax in respect of second-hand gold
sources.what: Gold coins contemplated in section 11(1)(k) of the VAT Act (the zero-rating section) are the gold coins issued by the South African Reserve Bank, including Krugerrands; gold bars and ingots are treated separately as goods consisting solely of gold and are not within the coin zero-rating, so bars carry 15%.

sources.name: MetCon - Buy Back Undertaking Policy
sources.what: Dealer/refiner's published buy-back rate table, re-read 28 Nov 2026: minted gold bars bought back at metal price -2.00%, minted and cast silver bars at metal price -5.00%, priced off the prevailing spot price; VAT is added to the buy-back price for SA residents where the undamaged bar was originally bought including VAT.

sources.name: MetCon - 10g Fine Gold Minted Bar MC Squared
sources.what: Dealer's own product page read 28 Nov 2026: the 10g bar is priced R25,846.73 incl. VAT, confirming bars are sold VAT-inclusive at 15%; the site's live ZAR/g spot price is script-rendered and could not be read, so no bar premium was calculated.
